principle: Hold the five-star PDE-002 portrait treatment, subject geometry, light background foundation, duration, and delivery format constant. Change only the layer behind the isolated Infinity subject.

recipes.name: Momentum wake
recipes.description: A broad, warm tonal wake gathers behind the implied direction of the pose without becoming a literal trail.

recipes.name: Photographic emulsion bloom
recipes.description: Large, irregular regions of photographic density emerge and recede in the light background.

recipes.name: Floating photographic print
recipes.description: A soft changing cast shadow makes the isolated figure feel fractionally suspended above the background.

recipes.name: Negative-space aperture
recipes.description: The empty space subtly opens around the face and gesture while the outer background gains density.

recipes.name: Residual gesture
recipes.description: Faint, displaced impressions suggest that the background remembers another instant in the gesture.

recipes.name: Incomplete geometry
recipes.description: Sparse arcs, points, and relationships appear without resolving into an explanatory diagram.

recipes.name: Borrowed-color field
recipes.description: Large atmospheric fields borrow restrained skin and clothing colors from the person.
